name: html-column-flex-growing-item-definite-height
description: Two grid cells in a section, each holding a `height:100%` column-flex block. In the first, the block's content wrapper grows (`flex:var(--content-flex,0)` with `--content-flex:1`), and inside it a `height:100%` flex wrapper stretches a button link with `height:100%` and flex centring. A growing flex item's post-flexing main size is definite when its column flex container's height is (CSS Flexbox 9.8), so the wrapper's `height:100%` resolves and the button fills the cell. The projector must keep that `height:100%` (and the carrier fill down to the core/button link) instead of demoting it to `height:auto`. In the second cell the content wrapper does not grow (`flex:0 0 auto`), so its child's `height:100%` still has no definite size to resolve against and is still demoted.

source_reference.notes: Regression coverage for grid-cell buttons stretched with height:100% that rendered at their content height (Automattic/blocks-engine#2185).

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
